page.overview:
Who is Petra?

Petra is a non-canon character that appears in the Mortal Kombat: Conquest episode "Debt of the Dragon". She was portrayed by Arian Ash.

Petra was a member of the Black Dragon organization and presumably the lover of Kebral. Her fate is unknown as she was not seen again after Kebral was killed by Jola. .
